description: This Java class 'AccountService' provides methods to access bank and utility account data, utilizing repositories for data retrieval and mappers for DTO conversion. It handles account lookups by account number, provider name, or ID and manages exceptions when entities are not found.

classes.name: AccountService
classes.description: A service class managing bank and utility account retrieval operations, integrating repositories, mappers, and exception handling.

methods.name: readBankAccount
methods.description: Retrieves a BankAccount DTO by account number, throwing EntityNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: readUtilityAccount
methods.description: Overloaded method to retrieve a UtilityAccount DTO by provider name or account ID, throwing EntityNotFoundException if not found.
